title: CGT method statement and all CGT events (Div 102 + Div 104)
summary: The Div 102 method statement (s 102-5) computes the net capital gain: gains and losses per CGT event, CGT discount for eligible gains (Div 115), loss offset (current then prior years, ss 102-10/102-15), and inclusion in assessable income. Div 104 defines all 53 CGT events A1-L8 (the s 104-5 table is the authoritative completeness list): disposals (A1), use and enjoyment (B1), loss/destruction and endings (C1-C3), rights creation (D1-D4), trusts (E1-E10), leases (F1-F5), shares (G1/G3), special receipts (H1-H2), residency ends (I1-I2), roll-over recapture (J1-J6), special events (K1-K12) and consolidation (L1-L8). Subsection coverage: Div 102 steps 1-4 of s 102-5 mapped; all 53 events from the s 104-5 table mapped; s 104-5 subsection detail per event (time, gain formula) carried in node bodies; Div 115 discount percentage and Div 112 modifications are separate maps.

nodes.label: A CGT event happens to you (or you are otherwise within Div 102)
nodes.body: Part 3-1 of ITAA 1997 taxes net capital gains. The method statement in s 102-5: work out your capital gains and capital losses for the income year from each CGT event, apply the CGT discount to eligible gains, reduce gains by losses (current year then prior years), and the net capital gain is included in assessable income. Capital losses cannot be deducted from other income — only against capital gains.

statute.title: What this Division is about
Method statement

nodes.label: STEP 1 — Work out your capital gains and capital losses for the income year
nodes.body: For each CGT event, work out the capital gain (capital proceeds less cost base) or capital loss (reduced cost base less capital proceeds). The event table in s 104-5 specifies the gain/loss formula for each event (A1-L8).

statute.title: Summary of the CGT events

nodes.label: STEP 2 — Apply the CGT discount to eligible capital gains
nodes.body: If the gain is a discount capital gain (asset held 12+ months, made by an individual/trust/super fund — see Div 115), apply the discount percentage (50% individuals/trusts, 33.33% complying super funds). Companies do not get the discount.

statute.title: Discount percentage for individuals and trusts

nodes.label: STEP 3 — Reduce your capital gains by capital losses
nodes.body: Reduce capital gains by current-year capital losses, then by unapplied prior-year net capital losses (s 102-5 step 3, s 102-15). Losses cannot be deducted against ordinary income (s 102-10).

statute.title: Losses cannot be deducted from exempt income
Net capital losses
Companies: capital gains
Trusts: capital gains

nodes.label: NET CAPITAL GAIN — included in assessable income
nodes.body: The net capital gain (STEP 4 of the method statement) is included in your assessable income. If capital losses exceed gains, there is no net capital gain — the excess is carried forward as a net capital loss.

nodes.label: Which CGT event applies?
nodes.body: Section 104-5 summarises all CGT events A1 to L8. The event determines the time of the event, the gain/loss formula, and the applicable rules. Match the facts to the event description: disposals (A1), loss/destruction (C1), cancellation (C2), rights creation (D1), trusts (E1-E10), leases (F1-F5), shares (G1/G3), residency ends (I1/I2), roll-over recapture (J1-J6), and the special events (K1-K12, L1-L8).

statute.title: Summary of the CGT events

nodes.label: CGT event A1 — Disposal of a CGT asset
nodes.body: You dispose of a CGT asset — time of event is when the disposal contract is entered into, or if none, when you stop being the owner. Gain = capital proceeds less cost base; loss = reduced cost base less proceeds. [s 104-10]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Disposal of a CGT asset

nodes.label: CGT event B1 — Use and enjoyment before title passes
nodes.body: Use and enjoyment of a CGT asset passes to another before title passes. Gain/loss as for A1 at the time use passes. [s 104-15]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Use and enjoyment before title passes

nodes.label: CGT event C1 — Loss or destruction of a CGT asset
nodes.body: Your CGT asset is lost or destroyed. Time is when compensation is first received, or if none, when the loss/destruction occurred. [s 104-20]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Loss or destruction of a CGT asset

nodes.label: CGT event C2 — Cancellation, surrender and similar endings
nodes.body: A CGT asset ends — cancellation, surrender, redemption, expiry, etc. Time is when the ending contract is entered into, or if none, when the asset ends. [s 104-25]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Cancellation, surrender and similar endings

nodes.label: CGT event C3 — End of option to acquire shares etc.
nodes.body: An option you granted to acquire shares/units ends. Time is when the option ends. Gain = option proceeds less expenditure in granting it. [s 104-30]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: End of option to acquire shares etc.

nodes.label: CGT event D1 — Creating contractual or other rights
nodes.body: You create contractual or other legal or equitable rights in another entity. Time is when the contract is entered into or the right is created. [s 104-35]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Creating contractual or other rights

nodes.label: CGT event D2 — Granting an option
nodes.body: You grant an option to another entity. Time is when the option is granted. Gain = option proceeds less expenditure to grant it. [s 104-40]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Granting an option

nodes.label: CGT event D3 — Granting a right to income from mining
nodes.body: You grant a right to receive income from mining on your land. Time is when the contract is entered into. [s 104-45]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Granting a right to income from mining

nodes.label: CGT event D4 — Entering into a conservation covenant
nodes.body: You enter into a conservation covenant over land you own. Time is when the covenant is entered into. The cost base is apportioned. [s 104-47]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Entering into a conservation covenant

nodes.label: CGT event E1 — Creating a trust over a CGT asset
nodes.body: You create a trust over a CGT asset. Time is when the trust is created. Gain = capital proceeds from creating the trust less the asset's cost base. [s 104-55]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Creating a trust over a CGT asset

nodes.label: CGT event E2 — Transferring a CGT asset to a trust
nodes.body: You transfer a CGT asset to an existing trust. Time is when the asset is transferred. This event is superseded for most transfers after 8 Dec 1997 by E1. [s 104-60]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Transferring a CGT asset to a trust

nodes.label: CGT event E3 — Converting a trust to a unit trust
nodes.body: A trust you have an interest in is converted into a unit trust. Time is when the conversion happens. Gain = market value of the asset at that time less cost base. [s 104-65]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Converting a trust to a unit trust

nodes.label: CGT event E4 — Capital payment for trust interest
nodes.body: The trustee makes a non-assessable capital payment to you for your trust interest. Time is when the payment is made. Gain = non-assessable part less cost base. [s 104-70]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Capital payment for trust interest

nodes.label: CGT event E5 — Beneficiary becoming entitled to a trust asset
nodes.body: A beneficiary becomes absolutely entitled to a CGT asset of the trust. Time is when the beneficiary becomes absolutely entitled. [s 104-75]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Beneficiary becoming entitled to a trust asset

nodes.label: CGT event E6 — Disposal to a non-resident trust
nodes.body: You dispose of an asset to a non-resident trust. Time is when the disposal happens. Gain = market value at that time less cost base. [s 104-80]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Disposal to a non-resident trust

nodes.label: CGT event E7 — Disposal to a non-resident company
nodes.body: You dispose of an asset to a non-resident company. Time is when the disposal happens. Gain = market value at that time less cost base. [s 104-85]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Disposal to a non-resident company

nodes.label: CGT event E8 — Disposal by a trust to a non-resident entity
nodes.body: A trust disposes of an asset to a non-resident entity. Time is when the disposal happens. The trust is treated as having made a gain. [s 104-90]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Disposal by a trust to a non-resident entity

nodes.label: CGT event E9 — Creating a trust over future property
nodes.body: You create a trust over future property. Time is when the trust is created. [s 104-105]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Creating a trust over future property

nodes.label: CGT event E10 — Annual cost base reduction for a trust interest
nodes.body: The cost base of your interest in a trust is reduced by an amount each year. Time is the end of the income year. [s 104-107A]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Annual cost base reduction for a trust interest

nodes.label: CGT event F1 — Granting a lease
nodes.body: You grant a lease over land. Time is when the lease is granted. The capital proceeds include amounts received for the grant. [s 104-110]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Granting a lease

nodes.label: CGT event F2 — Granting a long-term lease
nodes.body: You grant a lease for at least 99 years. Treated as a disposal of the land (CGT event A1 applies instead). [s 104-115]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Granting a long-term lease

nodes.label: CGT event F3 — Lessor pays lessee to obtain lease surrender
nodes.body: A lessor pays the lessee to obtain surrender of the lease. Time is when the lease term ends. [s 104-120]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Lessor pays lessee to obtain lease surrender

nodes.label: CGT event F4 — Lessee receives payment for lease variation
nodes.body: A lessee receives a payment for agreeing to a lease variation. Time is when the lease term ends. [s 104-125]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Lessee receives payment for lease variation

nodes.label: CGT event F5 — Lessor receives payment for lease variation
nodes.body: A lessor receives a payment for agreeing to a lease variation. Time is when the variation is made. [s 104-130]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Lessor receives payment for lease variation

nodes.label: CGT event G1 — Capital payment for shares
nodes.body: A company makes a non-assessable capital payment to you for your shares. Time is when the payment is made. Gain = non-assessable part less cost base. [s 104-135]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Capital payment for shares

nodes.label: CGT event G3 — Liquidator or administrator declares shares worthless
nodes.body: A liquidator or administrator declares your shares worthless. Time is when the declaration is made. You can choose to make a capital loss. [s 104-145]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Liquidator or administrator declares shares worthless

nodes.label: CGT event H1 — Forfeiture of a deposit
nodes.body: A deposit you paid for the purchase of property is forfeited. Time is when the deposit is forfeited. You make a capital loss. [s 104-150]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Forfeiture of a deposit

nodes.label: CGT event H2 — Receipt for granting an option
nodes.body: You receive an amount for granting an option (but D2 may apply). Time is when the act, transaction or event happens. [s 104-155]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Receipt for granting an option

nodes.label: CGT event I1 — Individual or company stops being an Australian resident
nodes.body: You stop being an Australian resident. Time is when you stop being a resident. You are treated as having disposed of all CGT assets (except TAP and pre-CGT assets) at market value — the 'deemed disposal' on departure. [s 104-160]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Individual or company stops being an Australian resident

nodes.label: CGT event I2 — Trust stops being a resident trust
nodes.body: A trust stops being a resident trust for CGT purposes. Time is when the trust stops being a resident trust. Deemed disposal of assets at market value. [s 104-170]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Trust stops being a resident trust

nodes.label: CGT event J1 — Company stops being a member of a wholly-owned group
nodes.body: A company stops being a member of a wholly-owned group where a roll-over applied to an asset transfer. Time is when the company stops being a member. [s 104-175]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Company stops being a member of a wholly-owned group

nodes.label: CGT event J2 — Change in relation to a replacement asset
nodes.body: A change occurs in the ownership of a replacement asset for which a roll-over was obtained. Time is when the change occurs. Recaptures the disregarded gain. [s 104-185]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Change in relation to a replacement asset

nodes.label: CGT event J4 — Trust fails to cease to exist
nodes.body: A trust that was to cease to exist under a roll-over fails to do so. Time is when it fails. [s 104-195]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Trust fails to cease to exist

nodes.label: CGT event J5 — Failure to acquire a replacement asset
nodes.body: You fail to acquire a qualifying replacement asset within the period for a roll-over. Time is the end of the period. Recaptures the gain. [s 104-197]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Failure to acquire a replacement asset

nodes.label: CGT event J6 — Cost of acquisition of a replacement asset is reduced to nil
nodes.body: The cost base of a replacement asset is reduced to nil by a roll-over, then a further reduction would be required. Time is when the further reduction would be made. [s 104-198]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Cost of acquisition of a replacement asset is reduced to nil

nodes.label: CGT event K1 — As the result of an act, transaction or event
nodes.body: A CGT asset starts being a taxable Australian property. Time is when the act, transaction or event happens. Special rule for assets that become TAP. [s 104-205]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: As the result of an act, transaction or event

nodes.label: CGT event K2 — Bankrupt pays amount in relation to a debt
nodes.body: A bankrupt pays an amount in relation to a debt. Time is when the payment is made. [s 104-210]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Bankrupt pays amount in relation to a debt

nodes.label: CGT event K3 — Asset passing to a beneficiary of a deceased estate
nodes.body: A CGT asset passes to a beneficiary of a deceased estate (other than a trustee). Time is when the asset passes. Special rules apply. [s 104-215]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Asset passing to a beneficiary of a deceased estate

nodes.label: CGT event K4 — CGT asset starts being held on trust
nodes.body: A CGT asset starts being held on trust for a beneficiary absolutely entitled (or a trustee under a will). Time is when it starts being held. [s 104-220]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: CGT asset starts being held on trust

nodes.label: CGT event K5 — Special capital loss from a collectable or personal use asset
nodes.body: A collectable or personal use asset is lost or destroyed and you receive an amount. Time is when the loss/destruction happens. [s 104-225]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Special capital loss from a collectable or personal use asset

nodes.label: CGT event K6 — Pre-CGT shares or trust interests
nodes.body: Another entity (the interposed entity) starts owning shares/units in an entity whose assets include pre-CGT shares. Time is when the interposed entity starts owning them. Gain = market value of the pre-CGT shares at that time. [s 104-230]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Pre-CGT shares or trust interests

nodes.label: CGT event K7 — Balancing adjustment on a depreciating asset
nodes.body: A balancing adjustment event occurs for a depreciating asset and you receive an amount. Time is when the balancing adjustment event occurs. Gain = balancing adjustment amount. [s 104-235]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Balancing adjustment on a depreciating asset

nodes.label: CGT event K9 — Entitlement to receive a payment
nodes.body: You become entitled to receive a payment (e.g. under an insurance policy or indemnity). Time is when you become entitled. [s 104-255]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Entitlement to receive a payment

nodes.label: CGT event K10 — You make a forex realisation gain
nodes.body: You make a forex realisation gain. Time is when the forex realisation event happens. [s 104-260]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: You make a forex realisation gain

nodes.label: CGT event K11 — You make a forex realisation loss
nodes.body: You make a forex realisation loss. Time is when the forex realisation event happens. [s 104-265]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: You make a forex realisation loss

nodes.label: CGT event K12 — Foreign hybrid loss
nodes.body: A loss from a foreign hybrid (within the meaning of the foreign hybrid rules). Time is when the loss is made. [s 104-270]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Foreign hybrid loss

nodes.label: CGT event L1 — Reduction under a consolidated group
nodes.body: An amount is reduced under the consolidation tax cost setting rules. Time is just after the entity joins the group. [s 104-500]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Reduction under a consolidated group

nodes.label: CGT event L2 — Amount remaining after an entity leaves a group
nodes.body: An amount remains after the exit rules apply to an entity leaving a consolidated group. Time is just after the entity leaves. [s 104-505]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Amount remaining after an entity leaves a group

nodes.label: CGT event L3 — Tax cost setting amount for a joining entity
nodes.body: A tax cost setting amount is set for a joining entity's assets. Time is just after the joining time. [s 104-510]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Tax cost setting amount for a joining entity

nodes.label: CGT event L4 — No reset cost base for a joining entity
nodes.body: A joining entity's asset does not have its cost base reset. Time is just after the joining time. [s 104-515]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: No reset cost base for a joining entity

nodes.label: CGT event L5 — Amount remaining after an entity leaves a group
nodes.body: An amount remains after the exit rules (L5). Time is when the entity leaves the group. [s 104-520]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Amount remaining after an entity leaves a group

nodes.label: CGT event L6 — Error in calculation of a tax cost setting amount
nodes.body: An error is made in calculating a tax cost setting amount. Time is when the error is discovered. [s 104-525]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Error in calculation of a tax cost setting amount

nodes.label: CGT event L8 — Reduction in tax cost setting amount
nodes.body: A tax cost setting amount is reduced. Time is just after the entity joins the group. [s 104-535]. Time of event and gain/loss formula per the s 104-5 table.

statute.title: Reduction in tax cost setting amount

nodes.label: Is the gain eligible for the CGT discount (held 12+ months, discount entity)?
nodes.body: A capital gain is a discount capital gain if the asset was held for at least 12 months (with exceptions for roll-overs and life insurance), the gain was not made by a company, and the CGT event happened after 21 September 1999 (ss 115-10, 115-15, 115-20, 115-25).

statute.title: When a capital gain is a discount capital gain
Discount percentage for individuals and trusts

nodes.label: Capital gain worked out — assessable after discount and loss offset
nodes.body: The gain feeds into the Div 102 method statement: apply the discount (if eligible), reduce by losses, and include the net capital gain in assessable income.

nodes.label: Capital loss — carried forward (can only offset capital gains)
nodes.body: A capital loss cannot be deducted from ordinary income. It reduces current-year capital gains first; any excess is carried forward to future years (s 102-15).

nodes.label: CGT position determined for this event

edges.label: No — not a discount gain (company, <12 months)
